verdict: Lead efficiency is up; pipeline capture and August milestones are being tightened.
narrative: This period your paid campaigns delivered 127 leads at a cost of $11.19 per lead — your most efficient 28-day stretch on record against your own baseline. Week-over-week, leads rose 28.57% while cost per lead fell 13.33%, confirming the improvement is real, not a budget spike. The most recent three days show leads holding steady at four per day, so the pace is stable rather than accelerating; ad creative and budget allocation are being reviewed to push past the plateau. Separately, 25 of the 127 leads are not yet showing as open opportunities in the CRM, which is an intake process gap, not an ads issue — that routing is being corrected now. August operational milestones, including attribution and credentials work, are closed out today, keeping the month-end scoreboard on track.
